text: FiiO names four inputs for this device and rates none of them, and this catalogue cannot record « this input exists » without also recording a ceiling. An input block with no fields would be the honest shape and reads as noise; leaving it out loses the fact that the device HAS an optical input at all. Found while populating from makers' own pages, which is where it matters: a maker is free to publish the silicon and skip the rates, and this one did.
